name: power_shift / radiance_shift / inverse_squared
plain: Picks table indices from a power curve, with midpoint_shift warping the input. power_shift with defaults equals inverse_squared. radiance_shift is the same formula with step+1, a discarded penultimate and its own defaults. All dedupe repeats, as with beta.
math:
M=len(S)−1. x_i=(i/n)^m, m=midpoint_shift.
t_i = rint((1−x_i^p)^p·M). σ_i=S[t_i] skipping repeats, then 0. Optional discard penultimate.
power_shift: n=steps, p=2, m=1. radiance_shift: n=steps+1, p=2.4, m=0.98, discard=True. inverse_squared: p=2, m=1.
